description: Aptech Limited operates as a learning solutions company in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Retail and Institutional. The company offers specialized courses in animation, VFX, game design, broadcast, and digital design, as well as filmmaking; courses in cosmetology, makeup, hair styling, skin care, and personal grooming for careers in the fashion, beauty, and wellness industry; and job-oriented courses in aviation, hospitality, travel and tourism, event management, and luxury retail. It also provides IT courses, such as software development, hardware and networking, AI and ML, and cybersecurity; media and entertainment training; testing and assessment services for government, corporate, and institutions; and training in emerging technologies, leadership, communication, and finance; on-campus and online instructor-led and job-focused training programs; hardware and networking courses; and English language programs. In addition, the company operates a preschool chain. It offers its products under the Arena Animation, Maya Academy of Advanced Creativity, Lakme Academy, Avalon Academy, Aptech Learning, The Virtual Production Academy, Aptech International Preschool, Aptech Assessment & Testing Solutions, Aptech Training Solutions, Education Institutes and Corporates (EIC) Unit, Aptech Computer Education, Aptech Hardware & Networking Academy, and Aptech English Learning Academy brand names. Aptech Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.
